$comment: Recorded dispositions for production dependency advisories.
The audit gate fails on any advisory that is not listed here, so a new one
has to be looked at rather than accumulating in a report nobody reads.
Re-check each entry when its package or its parent is upgraded.

accepted.title: Stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs
reason: Reached only through Prisma's configuration loader, which runs at CLI
and startup time against prisma.config.ts and prisma.indexer.config.ts.
Those are files in this repository, not request input. No source file
imports deepmerge-ts, and no HTTP handler reaches it.
The advisory needs an attacker-supplied recursive object graph; nothing
on any request path merges one.
